material_scope: Base requirements for forgings and wrought products (tubulars, bars, mill shapes)
conditional_trigger: NDT as required by PO or EPS flowdown
sop_notes: Baseline spec — always active for forgings/wrought products
Refer to CMS-002-1 for API 6A PSL-3 75K yield strength bodies over 1000 lbs during heat treating
CMS-002 takes precedence over any conflict with material-specific CMS

material_scope: Charpy / CVN impact framework and acceptance logic
typical_mtr_evidence: Individual and average absorbed energy values
sop_notes: Apply in conjunction with CMS-002 and material-specific CMS whenever Charpy is required by PO/EPS
Verify LAB-001 scope explicitly covers CVN impact testing capability

conditional_trigger: UT required per PO or EPS; additional CNT-* per flowdown
sop_notes: Tight chemistry and HT window — validate element-by-element including residuals
Hardness caps apply — check sour-service limits if NACE/ISO 15156 flowed down

conditional_trigger: UT and additional CNT-* per PO/EPS flowdown
typical_mtr_evidence: Heat treat window (austenitize / quench / temper actuals)
sop_notes: Higher hardenability than 4140 — quench media and section size controls are critical
Confirm HT supplier site-level approval (not company-level only)

material_scope: 17-4PH precipitation hardening stainless — NACE / corrosion-resistant route
sop_notes: Validate aging condition (H900/H1025/H1150 etc.) matches PO/EPS requirement
If NACE route: verify hardness cap compliance and modified chemistry limits
Ferrite or deleterious phase checks may be required — confirm LAB-001 scope

material_scope: Alloy 718 / API 6ACRA / NACE route — nickel-base superalloy
conditional_trigger: Additional CNT-* as specified by PO/EPS
typical_mtr_evidence: Chemistry (full trace including Nb, Mo, Ti, Al)
Heat treat route (solution anneal + double age actuals)
sop_notes: Highest scrutiny spec — macroetch and microstructure phase evaluation required
Confirm LAB-001 scope covers ASTM A604, ASTM E1181, metallography, and phase evaluation
API 6ACRA traceability chain must be unbroken from melt to finished form
Single-source risk: verify CHT-GEN and CNT-005 are not single-source for this material route

material_scope: Surface treatment requirements — coatings and plating (when flowed by PO/EPS)
conditional_trigger: Only active when coating/plating is specified in PO or EPS
sop_notes: Validate at site level — company name alone is insufficient
CCS-612 and CST-811 flagged as single-source — risk review required before acceptance
Any outsourced coating/plating by primary supplier must also use approved provider list
